title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 1st Proof Morality And Miracles

questions.question: What did the traveler want to find?
questions.answer: He wanted to find his Master and Creator.

questions.question: Who did he decide to visit first in his mind?
questions.answer: He decided to visit Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Why did he choose this person first?
questions.answer: Because he saw him as the greatest and most famous of people.

questions.question: What did the traveler do in his mind to meet him?
questions.answer: He imagined going back to the Prophet’s blessed time.

questions.question: How did he see that time?
questions.answer: He saw it as a happy and blessed time.

questions.question: What made that time so special?
questions.answer: The Prophet brought light that changed people for the better.

questions.question: What kind of people were changed by that light?
questions.answer: People who had been very simple and unlearned.

questions.question: What did they become after that change?
questions.answer: They became leaders and teachers.

questions.question: Before asking about the Creator, what two things did the traveler want to learn about the Prophet?
questions.answer: He wanted to know his high worth and whether his words were true.

questions.question: How many broad proofs did the traveler plan to mention?
questions.answer: Nine.

questions.question: What does the first proof say about the Prophet’s character?
questions.answer: It says he had beautiful manners and many good qualities.

questions.question: Who else agreed that he had excellent qualities?
questions.answer: Even his enemies agreed.

questions.question: Name one miracle mentioned in the passage.
questions.answer: The moon was split.

questions.question: What is another miracle named in the passage?
questions.answer: Water flowed from his fingers for the army to drink.

questions.question: What happened when he threw dust at his enemies?
questions.answer: They ran away.

questions.question: About how many miracles does the passage say he had?
questions.answer: More than three hundred.

questions.question: What does having noble character and many miracles show about his speech?
questions.answer: It shows he was very truthful.

questions.question: According to the passage, what bad things do not fit such a person?
questions.answer: Lying, cheating, and making mistakes on purpose do not fit him.

questions.question: Who was the traveler speaking to at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: He was speaking to his own mind.

questions.question: What was he using to search for his Creator?
questions.answer: He was looking through the creatures in the universe.

questions.question: Which person did he say was the most shining in speech and mind?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: How long does the passage say his excellence and the Qur’an gave light?
questions.answer: For fourteen centuries.

questions.question: What did the traveler hope to get from the Prophet?
questions.answer: An answer to his big question.

questions.question: When he imagined the Prophet’s time, what did he notice about it?
questions.answer: It was a time of true happiness.

questions.question: How did the Prophet help his people?
questions.answer: He raised them from weakness and ignorance.

questions.question: What did those people later become in the world?
questions.answer: They became masters and teachers.

questions.question: Before asking about Allah, what did the traveler think he should check first?
questions.answer: He should check the Prophet’s worth, honesty, and truthfulness.

questions.question: Did the traveler list all the proofs he found?
questions.answer: No. He only gave a short mention of nine main ones.

questions.question: What is one reason the first proof is strong?
questions.answer: Even enemies admitted the Prophet had great character.

questions.question: Where does the passage say many of his miracles are mentioned?
questions.answer: In the Qur’an and in widely reported teachings.

questions.question: What miracle happened with the moon?
questions.answer: It was split by Allah’s permission.

questions.question: What miracle helped thirsty soldiers?
questions.answer: Water came from his fingers.

questions.question: Why do these miracles support his truthfulness?
questions.answer: Because Allah would not support a liar with such signs.

questions.question: What kind of person would lie, according to the passage?
questions.answer: A low and bad person.

questions.question: What conclusion did the traveler reach about the Prophet?
questions.answer: He was the most truthful of people.

questions.question: What was the traveler searching for in this passage?
questions.answer: He was searching for his Lord and Maker.

questions.question: Who did he think he should learn from first among creation?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What titles in the passage show the Prophet’s greatness among people?
questions.answer: He is shown as a great leader, ruler, and very wise speaker.

questions.question: What did the traveler do so he could think about meeting the Prophet?
questions.answer: He entered the Prophet’s time in his imagination.

questions.question: What feeling did that time give him?
questions.answer: It gave him a feeling of blessing and happiness.

questions.question: Why was that age full of goodness?
questions.answer: Because the Prophet brought guidance and light.

questions.question: What change happened to the people through that light?
questions.answer: They changed from being uneducated to teaching others.

questions.question: Why did the traveler not ask his biggest question right away?
questions.answer: Because he first wanted to be sure the Prophet was truthful.

questions.question: What three things did he begin to examine?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s value, honest speech, and true warnings.

questions.question: How many main proofs are briefly shared here?
questions.answer: Nine.

questions.question: In the first proof, what is said about the Prophet’s manners?
questions.answer: His manners and qualities were excellent.

questions.question: Why is it important that even enemies agreed about his good qualities?
questions.answer: It makes the proof stronger because even those against him admitted it.

questions.question: Give one miracle from the passage that involves enemies.
questions.answer: He threw dust, and the enemies fled.

questions.question: Give one miracle from the passage that helped believers.
questions.answer: His army drank water that came from his fingers.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of his miracles?
questions.answer: It says there were over three hundred.

questions.question: What does the traveler say is impossible for such a person to do?
questions.answer: To sink into lies, tricks, or falsehood.

questions.question: What main idea does the first proof teach?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s life and miracles show that he spoke the truth.

questions.question: What was the traveler trying to learn by looking at creation?
questions.answer: He was trying to learn about his Creator.

questions.question: Which created person did he think was the best one to visit first?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: According to the passage, what made the Prophet widely known through many years?
questions.answer: His excellence and the Qur’an.

questions.question: What length of time is mentioned for his influence?
questions.answer: Fourteen centuries.

questions.question: What happened to the age of the Prophet because of him?
questions.answer: It became a blessed and joyful age.

questions.question: What kind of people were changed by his message?
questions.answer: People who had little learning and little progress.

questions.question: Into what were they changed?
questions.answer: Into people who guided and taught the world.

questions.question: What did the traveler say he must know before asking about the Creator?
questions.answer: He must know the Prophet’s value and truthfulness.

questions.question: Did the traveler find only a few proofs or many proofs?
questions.answer: He found many proofs.

questions.question: How many of those proofs does he say he will mention briefly?
questions.answer: Nine.

questions.question: What does the first proof tell us about the Prophet’s personal qualities?
questions.answer: They were all beautiful and excellent.

questions.question: What shows that the miracles were not just a small rumor?
questions.answer: The passage says they are supported by clear verses and many strong reports.

questions.question: What happened to the moon in one miracle?
questions.answer: It split apart.

questions.question: What came from the Prophet’s fingers in another miracle?
questions.answer: Water came out.

questions.question: Who benefited from that water miracle?
questions.answer: His thirsty army.

questions.question: If a person has great character and many miracles, what does the traveler say about his words?
questions.answer: His words must be truthful.

questions.question: Which bad actions are far from such a person?
questions.answer: Deceiving, lying, and being wrong in a blameworthy way.

questions.question: At the beginning of the passage, whom did the traveler talk to?
questions.answer: He talked to himself, to his own intellect.

questions.question: What was his reason for meeting the Prophet first?
questions.answer: He thought the Prophet was the best guide among creation.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s place among leaders?
questions.answer: It says he was a great and accomplished leader.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s speech and mind?
questions.answer: His speech was lofty and his mind was brilliant.

questions.question: What did the traveler do in order to visit the Prophet?
questions.answer: He pictured himself in the Prophet’s blessed time.

questions.question: How did he describe that time after entering it in his mind?
questions.answer: He described it as a time of real happiness.

questions.question: What caused that happy change in history?
questions.answer: The light brought by the Prophet.

questions.question: What big change happened to the people because of that light?
questions.answer: They rose from being primitive and unlettered to being world teachers.

questions.question: Before asking about Allah, what did the traveler say should be checked?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s greatness, honesty, and truthfulness.

questions.question: How many major proofs did he say he would mention in short form?
questions.answer: Nine.

questions.question: What does the first proof say about the Prophet’s good character?
questions.answer: It says he had all kinds of fine qualities.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention the testimony of enemies?
questions.answer: To show that even opponents could not deny his goodness.

questions.question: Which miracle in the passage happened in the sky?
questions.answer: The splitting of the moon.

questions.question: Which miracle in the passage happened with water?
questions.answer: Water flowed from his fingers.

questions.question: Which miracle in the passage made enemies run away?
questions.answer: Throwing dust toward them by Allah’s help.

questions.question: What book is named for more details about the miracles?
questions.answer: The Miracles of Muhammad, also called The Nineteenth Letter.

questions.question: What final judgment does the traveler make about the Prophet’s speech?
questions.answer: He judges that the Prophet could not be a liar and must be truthful.

questions.question: What was the traveler’s goal in this part of the text?
questions.answer: His goal was to find his Master and Creator.

questions.question: Why did he turn first to Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him?
questions.answer: Because he believed he was the greatest guide among creatures.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Prophet lit up for many centuries?
questions.answer: He lit up fourteen centuries with his excellence and the Qur’an.

questions.question: What kind of age did the traveler see when he thought of the Prophet’s time?
questions.answer: He saw a blessed age full of happiness.

questions.question: What does this tell us about the Prophet’s effect on people?
questions.answer: It shows he brought goodness and guidance.

questions.question: What sort of people were changed through his message?
questions.answer: People who had been very unlearned and uncivilized.

questions.question: What did they become after learning from him?
questions.answer: They became leaders and teachers for others.

questions.answer: He wanted to know if the Prophet was truly honest and trustworthy.

questions.answer: Nine.

questions.answer: It is about the Prophet’s noble character and miracles.

questions.question: Who confirmed his beautiful character besides his followers?
questions.answer: Even his enemies confirmed it.

questions.answer: Water came from his fingers.

questions.question: Name one miracle that happened with his gesture.
questions.answer: The moon split with his pointing.

questions.question: Name one miracle that happened in battle.
questions.answer: Dust was thrown and the enemies fled.

questions.question: About how many miracles are mentioned overall?
questions.answer: More than three hundred.

questions.question: What does the traveler say a person with these signs would never do?
questions.answer: Such a person would never sink into lying or tricking people.

questions.question: What lesson should a student take from this passage about the Prophet?
questions.answer: The Prophet was truthful, noble, and sent with clear signs from Allah.
